title: Hurricane Harvey Update September 10, 2017
description: Texas Military Department dual status commander, Brigadier General Patrick Hamilton gives an update on ground operations in Southeastern Texas following Hurricane Harvey. Soldiers featured in the video are from Texas, Oklahoma, Utah and Arkansas. US Army Video by SGT Tim Beery.
keywords: FEMA, flooding, Arkansas National Guard, Port Arthur, Oklahoma, Oklahoma National Guard, Tim Beery, Orange, 128th MPAD, Nathaniel Free, Hurricane Harvey, #HurricaneHarvey, National Guard, army, Texas, Utah

transcript.text: - When this first started our primary mission was
search and rescue, first thing we're gonna do
is save lives.
Then we had the capability after that
to support the local officials with resources
from points of distribution for water.
We're also doing recovery operations, evacuations,
moving people out whose homes were flooded,
getting them to shelters, helping in the shelters.
We did hoist operations with aircraft.
At one point we had 160 aircraft,
30 C-130 aircraft for evacuation.
We evacuated the city of Galveston on the island.
And then hundred and hundreds of active duty trucks,
national guard trucks here to be able to help the citizens
get out of danger, get safe, secure.
And then provide them evacuation capability,
additional resources 'cause they don't have water or food.
We give them water, food, ice, just to sustain them
until the utilities and infrastructure can come back.
